instructions.name: claim
docs: Permissionless: credits winnings to the position owner's balance.

instructions.name: close_market
docs: Base-layer close for a market that was never delegated.

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Permissionless crank: liquidations and pre-close force closes.

instructions.name: rule
docs: Admin settles a dispute, or a market the oracle never proposed.

instructions.name: sweep
docs: Permissionless: returns the House's share of a resolved market.

instructions.name: undelegate_market
docs: Permissionless after close once every leveraged position is gone:
freezes the final mark and returns the market to the base layer.

errors.name: Math
errors.msg: Math overflow or invalid AMM state

errors.name: MarketNotOpen
errors.msg: Market is not open for trading

errors.name: WrongState
errors.msg: Market is in the wrong state for this action

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidity
errors.msg: Not enough lending liquidity for this leverage

errors.name: PriceOutOfRange
errors.msg: Price would leave the allowed range

errors.name: Unhealthy
errors.msg: Position would be liquidatable right away

fields.name: house_free
docs: House (protocol market maker) capital not committed to any market.

fields.name: final_price_yes
docs: Price of YES frozen when trading closed. Used for INVALID payouts.

fields.name: cash
docs: Complete sets minted (USDC held by the AMM side of the market).

fields.name: lend_pool
docs: USDC available to lend for leverage.

fields.name: debt
docs: Borrowed principal still owed to the market's lend pool.

fields.name: margin
docs: Own capital still at work in this position.
